description: This file defines internal semantic conventions and utility functions for handling HTTP attributes and status codes within the OpenTelemetry Go SDK, specifically for the internal package related to semantic conventions.

classes.name: SemanticConventions
classes.description: Struct holding keys and values for various HTTP and network attributes as per OpenTelemetry semantic conventions.

methods.name: NetAttributesFromHTTPRequest
methods.description: Generates network-related attributes from an HTTP request based on the network type.

methods.name: EndUserAttributesFromHTTPRequest
methods.description: Extracts end-user related attributes, such as username, from an HTTP request.

methods.name: HTTPClientAttributesFromHTTPRequest
methods.description: Generates HTTP client span attributes from an HTTP request.

methods.name: httpCommonAttributesFromHTTPRequest
methods.description: Helper to generate common HTTP attributes like User-Agent and Content-Length.

methods.name: httpBasicAttributesFromHTTPRequest
methods.description: Generates basic HTTP attributes such as scheme, host, flavor, and method.

methods.name: HTTPServerMetricAttributesFromHTTPRequest
methods.description: Generates low-cardinality server-side HTTP metrics attributes.

methods.name: HTTPServerAttributesFromHTTPRequest
methods.description: Generates server-side HTTP span attributes including target, server name, route, and client IP.

methods.name: HTTPAttributesFromHTTPStatusCode
methods.description: Generates span attributes based on HTTP status code.

methods.name: SpanStatusFromHTTPStatusCode
methods.description: Returns span status code and message based on HTTP status code.

methods.name: SpanStatusFromHTTPStatusCodeAndSpanKind
methods.description: Returns span status code and message based on HTTP status code and span kind, with special handling for server spans.

methods.name: validateHTTPStatusCode
methods.description: Validates if an HTTP status code falls within known valid ranges and returns corresponding span status code.

search-terms: Go internal package for HTTP attributes
